name: Gyropup on one FLEXVOLT (20 V mode)

hardware_allowance.note: bearings, shoulder bolts, inserts, fasteners, wiring

notes: DeWalt FLEXVOLT option (the user has 60 V FLEXVOLT packs). A FLEXVOLT pack is three 5-cell strings that the adapter switches between 20 V (5S3P) and 60 V (15S). Tool packs leave under-voltage and current limits to the tool, so the robot must enforce a 3.0 V/cell cut-off and a current limit.

requirements: steady 1 kHz loop independent of Linux
CAN to the motors (it owns the motor bus)
CAN to the J501's built-in CAN-FD for the Jetson link (a second bus, or one shared CAN-FD bus)
UART (TTL or RS-232) for the VN-100
options: a microcontroller with CAN from the user's own boards (to be named)
balance_controller.status: open: waiting for the user's microcontroller list

head_payload.name: Turret (separate project)
head_payload.note: Budget for the head payload interface (docs/head-payload.md); the turret itself is developed separately.
head_payload.magazine: drum or belt, swappable at the reload station (the dock)
